scope: CVG-004 bounded scheduled source for persisted current cancelled counter-sale snapshot

criteria.description: The scheduled report reuses the verified commercial-deleted-sales contract, remains database-backed and maps exactly the eleven persisted current-snapshot fields.
criteria.limitations: The source is a current cancelled snapshot; no cancellation history, event time, actor or reason is inferred.

criteria.description: The worker validates strict ISO dates, inverted periods and search length before querying, forwards normalized filters, requests the 10,001-row detection bound, rejects overflow and defensively reapplies tenant/status/period/search semantics.
criteria.limitations: The bound protects this scheduled execution path; target-scale and deployed database behavior remain outside this local gate.

criteria.description: Worker bootstrap composes the database-backed counter-sales source and the existing ReportsService scheduled job persists the filtered execution without adding an external provider dependency.
criteria.limitations: This slice proves local persisted execution with empty recipients; continuous distributed delivery, retries and observability are not certified.

criteria.description: Two real one-shot worker processes execute two due schedules for different accounts against disposable PostgreSQL, and each persisted execution contains only its own cancelled sale.
criteria.limitations: Disposable PostgreSQL and local one-shot processes do not certify target roles, target RLS, continuous worker topology or production delivery.

criteria.description: The intentional RED, worker regression, coverage, relevant build, static validators, security, formatting and diff hygiene remain green within the repository bar.
criteria.limitations: Coverage uses the repository's designated integration exclusions; remote CI, production, release and external homologation remain outside this gate.

criteria.description: A fresh read-only independent review was re-run after the test typing correction and returned bounded approval with no material residual finding in this scope.
criteria.limitations: The first review reported a stale TS2345 from the pre-correction test; re-review confirmed it closed. Approval is limited to this slice.

criteria.description: The scheduled result is reconciled without promoting CVG-004, Vetus parity, clinical parity, enterprise readiness, target operations or release acceptance.
criteria.limitations: Live Vetus parity remains 4/11 verified, clinical parity 2/3 and enterprise readiness 95/100 with open warnings/failure.

gaps: The current cancelled snapshot still does not provide cancellation history or exact Vetus dynamic-executor parity.
Disposable local PostgreSQL does not certify target grants, target RLS, deployed worker topology, provider delivery, backup/restore, RTO/RPO or production operations.
Other report families, external delivery, accessibility, operational LGPD, remote CI, global parity and release acceptance remain open.
conditions: Keep this result limited to the tenant-scoped scheduled read of persisted current cancelled counter-sale rows.
